publicationIdentity: observer UUID and feed epoch identify an observer turn; session/revision identify its published result, not the task creator
limitations: The event is emitted immediately after actual snapshot assignment, before environment validation; it is not successful write authority.
Native age is measured from native begin, not native end. Wall age is observed at publication; interpolation between samples assumes no wall clock jump.
A feed epoch change breaks retention inference. Invalidation clears snapshot to nil; no publication trace is fabricated for that separate assignment.
Overlapping user-activity tokens delimit explicit work envelopes; automatic recovery without a user activity is reported elsewhere.
Freshness alone does not mean a catalog is complete or that its windows are permitted for a write.
